qa_audit.doable_note: No BANNED capability remains (prior generative_expand was swapped out; vectorize/halftone/remove_bg/solid-fill are all allowed and headless). But two connector-fidelity gaps: (1) Step 14 uses image_fill_area to build a "wide banner / social-header lockup" from a square mark — image_fill_area only fills a masked region of an EXISTING image with solid color; it cannot expand/create a differently-sized canvas or composite a transparent foreground onto a new banner-sized background, so this deliverable is not achievable with the named tool (a true wide-banner would need canvas expansion = banned, or a layout/composite tool). (2) Step 12's single-color recolor uses the select_subject→invert_selection→fill_area chain that the image_fill_area docs explicitly warn against (transparent-PNG-as-mask = wrong polarity). Also step 11 image_invert_selection is a dead/unused step (spec self-admits).
